test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Adamant**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Adamant"** is the correct spelling.
 
• The spellings of other words are absolutely incorrect.
 
• **Adamant **refers to someone who is difficult or unwilling to change an idea or judgement.
 
 
• **Example: ***I have told her not to come here but she is adamant that she is coming here. *
 
 

The correct spelling is **Adamant**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The correct spelling of** Amorphuous is ****Amorphous** which means non-crystalline substances devoid of long-range order.
 
• The correct spelling of **Despottic is ****Despotic** which means someone who abuses their authority over others in a brutal or unfair manner.
 
• The correct spelling of **Contentous is C****ontentious** which means a person who is prone to conflict or quarrel.
